只查询，不允许任何写入或结构变更: Read-only; no writes or schema changes allowed
每次写入、DDL 或破坏性操作都先询问: Ask before every write, DDL, or destructive operation
非破坏性操作自动执行，破坏性操作仍询问: Auto-run non-destructive operations; ask for destructive ones
在审批策略允许的范围内全部自动执行: Automatically execute all actions allowed by the approval policy
浏览器要求 HTTPS 才能使用相机；请改用 https 地址打开，或手动输入: Browser requires HTTPS to use the camera; open with an https address or manually enter the Bridge address and pairing code.
未获得相机权限，可在系统设置中开启，或手动输入 Bridge 地址与配对码。: Camera permission not granted; enable it in system settings or manually enter the Bridge address and pairing code.
请先填写一个局域网 IP，例如 192.168.1.10: Please enter a LAN IP first, such as 192.168.1.10
HTTPS 页面不能扫描 HTTP 地址，请改用 https Bridge 或手: HTTPS pages cannot scan HTTP addresses; use an https Bridge or enter manually
没有发现同一网段的 Bridge；请确认 Bridge 绑定 0.0.0.0 且: No Bridge found on the same subnet; confirm Bridge is bound to 0.0.0.0 and the port is
会话消息将被永久删除，记忆会保留。: Session messages will be permanently deleted; memory will be retained.
标题和内容都不能为空: Title and content cannot be empty
给数据库做一次体检: Run a health check on the database
按 status 统计 orders 并画柱状图: Count orders by status and draw a bar chart
按分组统计并画柱状图: Count by group and draw a bar chart
检查 orders 的空值、重复主键: Check orders for null values and duplicate primary keys
检查当前表的空值、重复主键: Check current table for null values and duplicate primary keys
将清除设备上的 Bridge 地址与令牌。: This will clear the Bridge address and token on the device.
将覆盖当前库中的同名对象，确定继续？: This will overwrite same-named objects in the current database. Continue?
该引擎无服务器账户: No server accounts for this engine
当前引擎不支持账户管理。: The current engine does not support account management.
给当前数据库做一次完整体检，并列出可修复项: Run full health check on current database and list fixable issues
生成当前库的数据字典摘要: Generate data dictionary summary for current database
统计每张表的行数并画柱状图: Count rows per table and draw bar chart
找出最近失败或很慢的查询: Find recent failed or slow queries
对比当前库与另一个库的结构差异: Compare schema differences with another database
执行 SQL、导出、保存到仪表板: Execute SQL, export, save to dashboard
列 / 索引 / 加列 / 重命名 / 清空: Columns / indexes / add column / rename / truncate
刷新卡片、查看趋势、删除卡片: Refresh cards, view trends, delete cards
按对象与数据全文查找: Full-text search by objects and data
账户列表、创建、授权与删除: Account list, creation, authorization, and deletion
移动端通过 Bridge 安全访问数据库。会话、记忆与桌面端同步。: Mobile securely accesses databases via Bridge. Sessions, memory, and desktop stay in sync.
在桌面端打开「设置 → Bridge → 为移动端配对」生成，5 分钟内有效。: Generate it by opening 「Settings → Bridge → Pair for Mobile」 on desktop; valid for 5 minutes.
令牌来自 Bridge 启动日志或桌面端配对结果；生产环境请使用 TLS。: Token comes from Bridge startup logs or desktop pairing results; use TLS in production.
凭据只保存在设备安全存储；数据库密码从不下发到移动端。: Credentials are stored only in the device secure store; database passwords are never sent to mobile.
把桌面「为移动端配对」的二维码放入框内: Place the desktop 「Pair for Mobile」 QR code inside the frame
选一个目的即可，Agent 会自己理解并执行，不需要填参数。: Choose a goal; the Agent understands and executes it, no parameters needed.
当前连接没有表，或尚未加载结构。: The current connection has no tables, or the schema has not loaded.
移动端为只读浏览；写操作请交给桌面端或 AI 助手并在授权后执行。: Mobile is read-only; perform write operations on desktop or with the AI assistant after authorization.
连接的新增与编辑在桌面端完成；移动端通过 Bridge 读取，不保存数据库凭据。: Adding and editing connections is done on desktop; mobile reads via Bridge and does not store database credentials.
还没有记忆。与 AI 对话时它会自动沉淀事实、偏好与结论。: No memories yet. During AI conversations, it automatically captures facts, preferences, and conclusions.
当前连接没有可切换的数据库。: The current connection has no databases to switch to.
当前连接没有可引用表: The current connection has no reference tables
破坏性操作：可能永久删除数据，Agent 会按设置先尝试备份。: Destructive operation: may permanently delete data. Agent will attempt a backup first according to settings.
全自动仍会按审批策略拦截破坏性操作。: Fully automatic mode still blocks destructive operations according to approval policies.
用自然语言查询、建表、排查。工具调用、审批与记忆在桌面与移动端同步。: Query, create tables, and troubleshoot in natural language. Tool calls, approvals, and memories sync across desktop and mobile.
桌面端「设置 → 模型」中添加模型后可在此切换。: Add models in Desktop Settings → Models to switch here.
不下发推理参数，使用服务商默认档位: No reasoning parameters are sent; provider default tier is used
该表没有主键，无法按行编辑；可用 SQL 查询修改。: This table has no primary key and cannot be edited by row; modify it with SQL queries.
移动端新会话默认只读；破坏性操作即使在全自动模式下也需要审批。: New mobile sessions are read-only by default; destructive operations require approval even in fully automatic mode.
写一条只读 SQL，或直接执行 UPDATE / CREATE 等语句（只读连接: Write a read-only SQL statement, or directly execute statements such as UPDATE / CREATE (read-only connections will be rejected).
还没有备份。点击右上角「立即备份」生成 SQL 备份。: No backups yet. Click 「Backup Now」 in the top-right corner to generate a SQL backup.
还没有卡片。在 SQL 查询里执行一条只读 SQL，点「存为仪表板」。: No cards yet. Run a read-only SQL statement in the SQL query, then click 「Save as Dashboard」.
CSV 首行作为列名，按列名写入当前表；只读连接会被拒绝。: Use the first CSV row as column names and write to the current table by column name; read-only connections will be rejected.
选择一张表查看结构。: Select a table to view its structure.
还没有报告或对比产物。可在对话中使用 /report、/diff、/recon。: No reports or comparison artifacts yet. Use /report, /diff, or /recon in the conversation.
CSV 导入；CSV / JSON / XML / SQL / XLSX 导出: Import CSV；Export CSV / JSON / XML / SQL / XLSX
界面文案即时切换，只保存在本机。: UI text switches instantly，saved locally only。
